classification: Level B canonical matrix-integration infrastructure plus private concrete source consumer; no printed theorem attribution and no proof evidence
exact_sealed_P:
∀ {ι : Type u} {Ω : Type v} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [MeasurableSpace Ω]
  {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ],
  ∀ (f : Ω → Matrix ι ι ℝ), Integrable f μ →
    (∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (f ω).PosDef) → (∫ ω, f ω ∂μ).PosDef
exact_sealed_T:
∀ {d q : ℕ} (hq : 2 * q + 1 < d),
  let D := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)
  let E := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (q + 1))
  let Ω := Fin (q + 1) → D
  let μ : Measure Ω := Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin (q + 1) => stdGaussian D)
  let M := Matrix (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) ℝ
  let r : ℝ := ((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)
  let L : ℝ := 2 * r + 3 * Real.log (1000 * (d : ℝ))
  let α : Fin d → ℝ := fun i => ((i.val : ℝ) + 1 - 1 / 2) * Real.pi / (d : ℝ)
  let tvec : Fin d → Fin (q + 1) → ℝ := fun i k =>
    if k.val = 0 then 1 else Real.sqrt 2 * Real.cos ((k.val : ℝ) * α i)
  let row : Fin d → Ω → E := fun i ω =>
    WithLp.toLp 2 (fun b : Fin (q + 1) => ω b i)
  let Y : Fin d → Ω → M := fun i ω =>
    if ‖row i ω‖ ^ 2 ≤ L then
      (d : ℝ)⁻¹ • Matrix.kronecker
        (Matrix.vecMulVec (WithLp.ofLp (row i ω)) (WithLp.ofLp (row i ω)))
        (Matrix.vecMulVec (tvec i) (tvec i))
    else 0
  let mean : Fin d → M := fun i => ∫ ω, Y i ω ∂μ
  let Z : Fin d → Ω → M := fun i ω => Y i ω - mean i
  let w : Bool → Fin d → ℝ := fun useCos i =>
    if useCos = true then Real.cos (((2 * q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * α i) else 1
  let sign : Bool → ℝ := fun minus => if minus = true then -1 else 1
  let S : Bool → Bool → Ω → M := fun useCos minus ω =>
    sign minus • ∑ i : Fin d, w useCos i • Z i ω
  let Rstar : ℝ := 2 * r * (L + 1) / (d : ℝ)
  ∀ s : ℝ, ∀ useCos minus : Bool,
    let G : Ω → M := fun ω => NormedSpace.exp (s • S useCos minus ω)
    let MX : M := ∫ ω, G ω ∂μ
    let B : ℝ := r ^ 2 * Real.exp (|s| * ((d : ℝ) * Rstar))
    Integrable G μ ∧ MX.PosDef ∧
      Matrix.trace MX = (∫ ω, Matrix.trace (G ω) ∂μ) ∧
      0 < Matrix.trace MX ∧ Matrix.trace MX ≤ B

nodes.statement: On any probability space, an integrable finite real square-matrix field f with f(ω) PD a.e. has PD Bochner mean ∫f.
conditional_discharge: Self-adjointness of the integral follows by finite entrywise transpose/linear integration.
For each fixed nonzero real vector x, xᵀf(ω)x is integrable and positive a.e.; a probability measure has positive total mass, so its integral is positive.
Finite-sum/linear-map commutation identifies ∫xᵀf x with xᵀ(∫f)x. No uniform lower eigenvalue hypothesis is required.
Empty finite index carrier is allowed: positivity on nonzero vectors is vacuous; integral self-adjointness remains.

nodes.statement: The sealed finite product μ=⊗_{b∈Fin r}stdGaussian(R^d) is a probability measure; the sealed zero-based α,row,tvec,Y,mean,Z agree with the source one-based γ_i,t_i,Y_i,EY_i,Z_i.
conditional_discharge: d≥2 and r=q+1≥1; α_i=((i.val+1)−1/2)π/d is the source angle.
Each row is an N(0,I_r) vector; tvec matches the constant/cosine source vector coordinate by coordinate.
Finite product law is the full Gaussian law. Ex107 cutoff is incorporated in Y, never imposed by conditioning on T.
Y entries are measurable: Gaussian coordinates, polynomial products, finite Kronecker entries and the measurable cutoff.
consumer_use_sites: Sealed private T and all AD nodes below

nodes.statement: Every source-truncated Y_i is a bounded measurable finite-dimensional matrix field, hence Bochner integrable; mean_i is its actual integral and Z_i=Y_i−mean_i is a measurable symmetric field.
conditional_discharge: The source operator bound 2rL/d is finite; L>0 from d≥2,r≥1.
Finite-dimensional norm equivalence transports the operator-norm bound to any implementation norm used for Bochner integration.
Symmetry follows from real outer products, Kronecker product, scalar cutoff, and entrywise integration; no mean supplied as an extra binder.

nodes.statement: For each useCos,minus∈Bool and every ω, S=sign(minus)Σ_i w(useCos,i)Z_i(ω) is symmetric and ‖S‖op≤dR*; R*=2r(L+1)/d.
conditional_discharge: Ordinary w=1; cosine w=cos(nα_i) has |w|≤1.
Both signs have absolute value1; the triangle inequality over exactly d summands gives dR*.
R*≥0 and the bound holds pointwise on the entire product law, including outside T.

nodes.statement: For every real s and all four signed/weighted families, G(ω)=exp(sS(ω)) is measurable and Bochner integrable.
conditional_discharge: Matrix exponential is continuous; composing with measurable S is measurable.
Let c=|s|dR*≥0. Symmetry and ‖sS‖op≤c place every eigenvalue in[−c,c], giving ‖exp(sS)‖op≤exp(c).
Finite-dimensional norm equivalence and μ(Ω)=1 turn this uniform finite bound into Bochner integrability.
No s>0 or small-s condition is needed; s=0 and either sign are covered.

nodes.statement: For all real s, exp(sS(ω)) is symmetric positive definite at every ω.
conditional_discharge: sS is real symmetric; spectral mapping gives strictly positive exp eigenvalues.

nodes.statement: The actual mean MX=∫G is positive definite.
conditional_discharge: Choose one of the independent sufficient routes R-T-P OR R-T-UNIFORM below; do not require both.
Trace is a continuous linear functional/finite sum of integrable diagonal coordinates; commute it with the Bochner integral.
The matrix index Fin r×Fin r is nonempty because r≥1, so a PD matrix has positive diagonal entries and strictly positive finite trace.
Generic P itself does not assume nonempty indices; that condition is required here for strict trace positivity.
Pointwise exp eigenvalues≤exp(c), so trG≤Nexp(c), N=card(Fin r×Fin r)=r².
Integrate the pointwise bound on the probability measure and use trace commutation.
This is a deterministic dimension envelope; it does not use independence, centering, variance, Lieb, or Bernstein.
